name: System of Equations Intersection Substitution
description: Replaces the "product is not a perfect square" constraint with a geometric constraint requiring two lines ($s_u x + s_v y = 1$ and $s_v x + s_u y = 1$) to intersect at exactly one point. This requires the model to deduce that the lines are distinct and non-parallel, which mathematically reduces to $s_u \neq s_v$. Models relying on surface pattern matching will fail to recognize the 3-coloring reduction or will misimplement the line intersection check.
